ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (dark) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for approximately 15%, primarily in concentrated medial and distal patches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast mottling localized in the medial regions of both lobes; distinct vertical white bands and fragmented spots are mapped to the distal quadrant of the right lobe near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped notch with a vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees and a depth ratio of roughly 0.15 relative to the horizontal span of a single lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, with peak-to-valley pixel amplitude variations of approximately 5-10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a distinct concave curvature leading to rounded and slightly dorsally-upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of circular high-contrast white pixels localized on the distal-ventral section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical linear pixel disruptions (white streaks) localized on the right lobe, perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant indentation on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, distinguishable from the standard serration pattern by its increased depth and irregular contour.
